title: Schools Covered under PM SHRI Scheme
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Education

Schools Covered under PM SHRI Scheme

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
27 JUL 2026 5:27PM by PIB Delhi

The State/UT-wise number of schools covered under the Pradhan Mantri Schools for Rising India (PM SHRI) scheme, and the details of teachers appointed in these schools for non-Hindi native languages, language-wise and State/UT-wise, are provided in the
Annexure
.

The Pradhan Mantri Schools for Rising India (PM SHRI) is a centrally sponsored scheme which aims to strengthen more than 14,500 schools across the country. As of now, a total of 13,092 schools have been selected as PM SHRI schools across the States/Union Territories, including Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS)/Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS)/NCERT.

This information was given by
Minister of State for Education, Shri Jayant Chaudhary
, in a written reply in Lok Sabha today.

Annexure
